about: Curated shopfronts and terraces of the shopfront kit (viewer/shops/shopLayout.js), each checked on Google Street View (look only, never traced or stored; docs/assets/SHOPS.md). terraces.<OSM id>: depth (m out from the wall), from / to (m along the front, left to right seen from the street), hedge (planters along the outer edge), parasols, parasol (canvas palette index), none (no terrace); front: family classic | modern, paint / canvas (palette index of shopLayout.js), awning, stripes, lightbox.

osm:n11685293316._name: Le refuge, Ch. de Saint-Job (ex Au Petit Job): a front-yard terrace behind a clipped hedge, square parasols, dark bistro chairs; blue awning with lettering on the valance

osm:n10904517080._name: Miska (the ice-cream / cupcake cafe next to the coiffeur): a raised timber deck with a white railing in front, a few tables

osm:n11685233717._name: Chez Clementine, Place de Saint-Job: the glazed pavilion's covered terrace with long tables (no parasols: under its roof)

osm:n6966406037._name: Madonna: no terrace on Street View (2024)

osm:n3981790357._name: Pizza Hut, Place de Saint-Job: brick front with arched windows, red fascia on Street View; no terrace

osm:n5501826363._name: Au Repos de la Montagne, Montagne de Saint-Job (OSM outdoor_seating=yes): tables along the front, parasols

osm:n4361797887._name: Barat (bakery, Place de Saint-Job 36): on Street View 2024 a black fascia board with three gooseneck spotlights over a roller-shutter front (the shop now trades as another bakery)

osm:n5520234527._name: Le Bouquet Varie (florist): a grey retractable awning over the front, plants on the pavement

osm:n5520234525._name: Espace photo: grey fascia, painted stall risers (red panels on Street View)

osm:n10864464955._name: St-Job (butcher, Av. du Prince de Ligne): grey fascia with white lettering and a grey canopy over the window
